failures.description: Historical V3.3.1 nominal OOS coverage point estimate (93.67%) failed the 95.0% target on frozen dataset. While Model H achieves 95.17%, mean interval width expanded by 11.0% (0.2312m vs 0.2083m) and required pitch-specific localized variance scaling.
